M_SWB.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] Players who were cut/dropped-out had lower self-esteem and positive affect as season one progressed (M_{\text{wavel}} = 5.68, 5.76; M_{\text{wave2}} = 5.14, 5.11), compared with the stable level of self-esteem and positive affectivity experienced by participants who remained in the program (M_{\text{wavel}} = 5.94, 6.01; M_{\text{wave2}} = 5.93, 5.98).
